causes.label: demand
causes.quote: The temperature in western Sydney reached 40°C with demand reaching a maximum of 12 808 MW at 4 pm, which was slightly higher than forecast.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: A planned transmission network outage between Sydney West and Yass exacerbated the impact of the system normal constraint until midday, when the line was returned to service earlier than forecast.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: The market impact of this constraint was made significantly worse following rebidding by Delta Electricity⎯initially by shifting capacity into higher prices and then reducing its generator ramp rates and maximum availability.

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: At 10.30 am Delta Electricity reduced the 'ramp down rates' of Mount Piper. Due to Mount Piper's ramp rate being lowered, other generators and interconnectors were required to be constrained-off so that the constraint was not breached.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: Flows across Victoria to New South Wales interconnector decreased from 900 MW at 11 am (into New South Wales) to 175 MW into Victoria at 12 pm.

constraints_named.quote: The system normal constraint N>>N-NIL__S bound for much of 7 December.

interconnectors_named.name: VIC-NSW
interconnectors_named.quote: Flows across Victoria to New South Wales interconnector decreased from 900 MW at 11 am (into New South Wales) to 175 MW into Victoria at 12 pm.

interconnectors_named.name: QNI
interconnectors_named.quote: The combined flows across the Terranora and QNI interconnectors also decreased from 349 MW at 11 am (into New South Wales) to 244 MW into Queensland at 11.30 am.

interconnectors_named.name: Terranora
interconnectors_named.quote: The combined flows across the Terranora and QNI interconnectors also decreased from 349 MW at 11 am (into New South Wales) to 244 MW into Queensland at 11.30 am.

intervals.quote: On Monday 7 December 2009, the spot price in New South Wales exceeded $5000/MWh for six out of eight trading intervals between 12 pm and 3.30 pm inclusive.
intervals.text: six out of eight trading intervals between 12 pm and 3.30 pm inclusive

network_outages.quote: A planned transmission network outage between Sydney West and Yass exacerbated the impact of the system normal constraint until midday, when the line was returned to service earlier than forecast.

rebid_set_price.quote: The market impact of this constraint was made significantly worse following rebidding by Delta Electricity⎯initially by shifting capacity into higher prices and then reducing its generator ramp rates and maximum availability.
